name: c12b-check
description: Step C12b books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5) through soap, oil, emulsion and linker springs, a quarter of the cells given a wall and oil (30 s), N (60 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s), G (200 s), a resize back (220 s), new springs of every kind (240 s), every new switch and the membrane's off and on at runtime (255 to 340 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (380 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.65, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.7, v.cssH * 0.65, 'emulsion', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); return moire.matter.springs.length
await moire.genome.setAll({ wall: 0.8, wallRow: 0.5, oilShare: 0.5 }, { cells: Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, k) => 4 * k) }); return 'a quarter of the slots walled and oily'
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'soap', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'linker', 200); return 1

{ const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'emulsion'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.7, 'soap'); } return moire.matter.springs.length
moire.lipids.params.heat = false; moire.lipids.params.crack = false; return 'heat, crack off'
moire.lipids.params.heat = true; moire.lipids.params.crack = true; moire.lipids.params.heads = false; return 'heads off'
moire.lipids.params.heads = true; moire.dipole.params.on = false; return 'dipoles off'
moire.dipole.params.on = true; moire.membrane.params.on = false; return 'membrane chemistry off'
moire.membrane.params.on = true; moire.oil.params.fusion = false; return 'fusion off'
moire.oil.params.fusion = true; moire.membrane.params.bites = false; moire.membrane.params.elastic = false; return 'bites, elastic off'
moire.membrane.params.bites = true; moire.membrane.params.elastic = true; return 'all on'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
